set.body: Goal: add an idiomatic Scala 3 latent archive subsystem to ScalaFIM, using neuroarchive as the semantic reference but not as an R6 or S3 port. Scope: a pure LNA-style archive contract, typed transform descriptors, payload manifests, validation layers, JVM HDF5 storage adapters, quant roundtrip support, dataset backend integration, later basis/embed/shared-basis latent pipelines, fixtures, and docs. Non-goals: porting every experimental transform first, plugin discovery as a mutable runtime registry, visualization/reporting, or coupling archive IO into numerical fitting modules. Done when child beads cover module scaffold, core model, validation, JVM storage, quant roundtrip, dataset backend integration, latent basis pipeline, docs, and acceptance tests.
set.title: Epic: ScalaFIM latent neuroarchive subsystem
